lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: In all my years of watching brutal violence unfold, this is without a doubt the most pointless, unnecessary savagery we have ever witnessed!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Aw, come on, this could be way worse. She still has all her vital organs. All of them.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I have to do something! I can't let this continue!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No, Gohan. If you step in, you'll be disqualified.
